trust_decision.summary: CSRF token is only checked for unsafe methods (POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH) in HTTPRequest.validate_csrf_token; a whitelisted function that still accepts GET (the default method set) can be driven cross-site by a logged-in user's Lax session cookie. Allowed methods per function are enforced by is_valid_http_method.

landing_point.why: The advisory title names confirm_action / workflow approval; an engineer goes to the workflow action endpoints first, then frappe/model/workflow.py.

fix_sites.module_kind: desk doctype controller (neighbouring feature: bulk submit/cancel/update)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: frappe/model/rename_doc.py:22 and frappe/desk/doctype/bulk_update/bulk_update.py:53 are fixed although the advisory is about workflow approval; both look unrelated to workflow

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about workflow approval, so rename/title and generic bulk submit/cancel/update look like neighbouring features; GET routes reached via run_doc_method / document-method APIs look like a separate 'controller method' mechanism outside the reported RPC function.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Email workflow links (apply_action, confirm_action) must stay GET: verify_request rejects anything but a signed GET with no body, so an over-broad 'POST-only for all workflow endpoints' fix breaks approval-by-email.

O6_input_shapes: HTTP method only: GET/QUERY rejected, POST accepted (method allow-list on the whitelist decorator)
docnames as JSON string or native list is unaffected by the fix (frappe/model/workflow.py:318-319)

O7_producer.where: Allowed-method table is filled by the whitelist decorator at frappe/__init__.py:615 and read at frappe/handler.py:110; it is a decorator registry, not a schema/serializer

O8_uncovered_routes.route: BulkUpdate.bulk_update doc method (default methods incl. GET) calls submit_cancel_or_update_docs in-process, reached via GET run_doc_method / document method APIs, bypassing the fixed decorator
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Internal Python call to the fixed function; a Desk form button with its own write-permission check, looks like the 'Bulk Update' UI, not the API
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as a fix site; entry via frappe/handler.py:295-328 and frappe/api/v2.py:626-630

O8_uncovered_routes.route: apply_workflow, the single-doc workflow transition that bulk_workflow_approval wraps, still accepts GET
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Single-document action used by the form UI; the advisory and fix name the bulk endpoint
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as fix site, 200 lines above

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Document.submit/cancel/discard/rename controller methods are whitelisted with default methods and are callable by GET via run_doc_method and v2 document-method route
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Generic document-method API in the base Document class; a lower-level mechanism, not a named endpoint in the report
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (frappe/model/document.py) plus routes in frappe/handler.py:295 and frappe/api/v2.py:641-645

O8_uncovered_routes.route: cancel_all_linked_docs cancels arbitrary submitted docs and accepts GET
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Linked-documents helper of the form view, not bulk or workflow

O8b_injection_room.sibling: remove_multiple bulk assignment removal left on default methods
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same 'bulk action from list view' family as the fixed endpoints; maintainers clearly whitelist these with bare @frappe.whitelist()

O8b_injection_room.sibling: add_tags bulk tagging left on default methods
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: List-view bulk operation next to bulk_operations.js callers; easy to miss when restricting bulk endpoints

O9_family: CSRF via state-changing endpoints accepting safe HTTP methods (CWE-352)

O10_build.toolchain: bench / pip, Python 3.x, Node for assets
O10_build.project_tests: frappe/workflow/doctype/workflow/test_workflow.py, frappe/desk/doctype/bulk_update/test_bulk_update.py, frappe/tests/test_rename_doc.py, frappe/tests/test_api.py (call functions directly or via test client)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add methods=["POST"] to bulk_workflow_approval only (or to every workflow endpoint, breaking signed GET email links in confirm_action/apply_action).

out_of_scope_notes: Many other bare @frappe.whitelist() state-changing functions exist across the tree (e.g. frappe/core/page/permission_manager/permission_manager.py:162); not part of this advisory's endpoints.
